basis: Owner requested a friend-ready print of RF02 with the smaller TR03 slots and less waste. Sacrificial temporary tool; no permanent retained liner or installed-water performance approval.

print.material: Unfilled PETG; use friend's established filament and matching profile
print.quantity: One D12 by default; D24_RELIEVED is an alternative, not an additional required print
print.orientation: Flat shower-facing face and locator tabs on bed; collar grows upward. Files are pre-oriented and translated to nonnegative XYZ.
print.transform_from_installed: x_print=x+120; y_print=120-y; z_print=8.05-z. Proper 180 degree X rotation plus translation, not reflection.
print.gcode: Not supplied: printer model, firmware, filament and profile unknown. Friend slices locally. Geometry-only 3MF has explicit mm, no machine settings.

engineering.thickness_choice: 8 mm chosen as a practical braced-tool compromise, not a proven minimum. Compared with RF02's 12 mm, reduce face material by one third; keep collar and slot XY. A thinner unsupported panel is less stiff, so retain broad padded independent support and rehearse seating/release before fill.
engineering.brace: Support the broad front annulus with padded bracing without obstructing controls or removal. Rods locate only; never tighten nuts to load the tabs or pull a warped face flat. Hand-place repair material; no pressure casting or tamping.
engineering.limits: Source capture clearance does not prove full-face seating, hidden clearances, print strength or suitability for a particular repair material. Check the physical print and brace before repair. Remove all plastic, release film and pads after suitable cure.
engineering.liner: Keep the existing removable approximately 0.05 mm PE release liner allowance; do not fill the central service opening or slots. Rear repair stays within the continuous front 12 mm zone even on D24_RELIEVED.
engineering.owner_measurements: None requested; printer model/bed is optional equipment information.

cost_assumptions.scope: One selected form, one successful print plus one retry. Budget assumptions, not a vendor quote or guarantee of friend's labor price. One kg covers two conservative solid-body prints with reasonable waste. Actual slicer reports supersede mass/time estimates.

sources.claim: Official category search returned standard 1 kg PETG listings at $25.49 sale; regional prices vary. Use $35/kg for conservative consumed-material budgeting, $45 delivered whole-spool allowance, not live checkout price.
PETG density 1.30 g/cm3 used as a conservative standard-unfilled-PETG mass assumption.
PETG functional use, material-specific print profile and suitable bed surface/release layer.
Perimeters and infill have different roles; 100 percent infill is usually unnecessary. Five walls/25 percent here are design choices, not manufacturer's certification of this tool.
